parameters.name: cameras
parameters.help_text: any of Face, Nose, Behavior; a camera with no video in the session is skipped (default Face,Nose,Behavior)

parameters.name: face-roi
parameters.help_text: 'auto' (default) centres a default-sized box on the session's motion; 'aligned' moves the built-in box (200,220,180,150) by this camera's rigid alignment to the reference session 786297_2025-05-20; 'default' uses the built-in box; or 'x,y,w,h' in pixels. Check qc/Face_roi_placement.png (and qc/Face_roi_alignment.png)

parameters.name: nose-roi
parameters.help_text: 'auto' (default) centres a default-sized box on the session's motion; 'aligned' moves the built-in box (110,110,240,210) by this camera's rigid alignment to the reference session 786297_2025-05-20; 'default' uses the built-in box; or 'x,y,w,h' in pixels. Check qc/Nose_roi_placement.png (and qc/Nose_roi_alignment.png)

parameters.name: behavior-roi
parameters.help_text: 'auto' (default) centres a default-sized box on the session's motion; 'aligned' moves the built-in box (120,185,180,90) by this camera's rigid alignment to the reference session 786297_2025-05-20; 'default' uses the built-in box; or 'x,y,w,h' in pixels. Check qc/Behavior_roi_placement.png (and qc/Behavior_roi_alignment.png)

parameters.name: sbin
parameters.description: spatial binning factor before the SVD
parameters.help_text: 2 halves each dimension (4× fewer pixels, ~4× faster) while preserving motion content; use 1 for full resolution (slower, may timeout on long sessions)

parameters.name: svd-components-saved
parameters.description: SVD components written to the outputs
parameters.help_text: facemap always computes 500; this many go into facemap_table.h5 and the mask .npy (default 100)

parameters.name: keyframe-handling
parameters.description: how the cleaned motion trace handles compression pops
parameters.help_text: interpolate | nan | none -- samples spanning an H.264 keyframe are always flagged; this sets what the cleaned copy does with them (default interpolate)

parameters.name: trim-leading-frames
parameters.description: drop the acquisition preamble before processing
parameters.help_text: auto detects the white metadata frame + exposure settling and trims losslessly to the next keyframe; 0 disables; or give an explicit frame count (default auto)

parameters.name: save-proc-npy
parameters.help_text: true | false -- the native file holds all 500 components and masks (~0.6 GB per camera) (default true)
